decisions.reason: The large bulk container is close to the core range, has its own page and sunk tooling and engineering investment, and is only one year on the market, so any weak results can still be read as a temporary ramp-up.
The valve complements the bulk-container line, is visibly presented on its own page and costs little to maintain, so dropping it would write off development effort without releasing much.

The take-back service is only mentioned on the website and so carries little visible commitment, but it fits the publicly announced circular, service-based strategy, which makes withdrawal hard to justify this early.
